test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

He was an irresponsible person __to the matter of taking up__ responsibilities.

options.text: at the matter of taking up
in the matter of taking up
by the matter of taking up
along the matter of taking up

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"in the matter of"** means concerning or regarding a particular subject or issue. (के मामले में) • **Example: **She is an expert **in the matter of** environmental conservation. • **Option 2** correctly uses the phrase **"in the matter of"** which is **grammatically appropriate for the sentence**. (के मामले में) • **Example: **He was an irresponsible person** in the matter of taking up** responsibilities. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: at the matter of taking up** (लेने के मामले में): This phrase is not grammatically correct in this context. • **Example:** Incorrect: He was an irresponsible person at the matter of taking up responsibilities. • **Option 3: by the matter of taking up** (लेने के मामले के द्वारा): This phrase is also not grammatically correct in this context. • **Example: **Incorrect: He was an irresponsible person by the matter of taking up responsibilities. • **Option 4: along the matter of taking up** (लेने के मामले के साथ): This phrase does not fit well in the given sentence. • **Example: **Incorrect: He was an irresponsible person along the matter of taking up responsibilities. 185:Tf7c,
